metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Diminished role in loss
metadata.description: Moreau played 21 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in the Texans' 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Moreau did not appear in the box score of Sunday's game. The tight end's nonexistent offensive production is a steep decline from his pair of TDs in the Texans' London victory over the Jaguars.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau Getting More Playing Time
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Foster Moreau only caught two passes last week in London against the Jaguars, but he found the end zone on both catches and finished with seven receiving yards to go with his two touchdowns. Just as important for his fantasy value, for the second time this season, Moreau played more snaps than Dalton Schultz, getting on the field for 39 snaps (62%) compared to Schultz's 25 snaps (40%). Moreau has exactly two catches in five of his six games this season and has been finding ways to chip in low-level production. He is extremely touchdown-dependent, but if his playing time continues to rise, he could be an interesting streaming option down the road. This week against the Giants, he is only the No. 43 TE in RotoBaller's rankings, so he can be left on the bench this week in all but the deepest of leagues.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Pair of TDs in London victory
metadata.description: Moreau caught both of his targets for seven yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.
metadata.analysis: Moreau made the most of his two opportunities, securing a pair of red-zone scores from one and six yards. Three of Moreau's 11 grabs this season have resulted in red-zone touchdowns. He can mostly be ignored in fantasy football while Dalton Schultz is healthy.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau hauls in two touchdown passes in Week 6
metadata.description: Foster Moreau caught both of his targets for seven yards and two touchdowns in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
metadata.analysis: Moreau has not seen enough playing time this season to be fantasy viable weekly. His two touchdown performance will spark some interest on the waiver wire, but it will be hard to trust the veteran moving forward.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau a DFS Punt Play vs. Jacksonville
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Foster Moreau has exactly two catches in four of his five games this season and did get into the end zone in Week 3 against the Colts. Moreau is the team's second tight end behind Dalton Schultz, and he doesn't get enough consistent work to be a regular fantasy option. He's ranked as only the No. 41 tight end in RotoBaller's Week 6 rankings. However, if you're starting your Sunday with a single-game DFS lineup, he does bring enough upside to be a viable bargain play since he does get a few opportunities in the team's game plan in most matchups.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau Only a Deep League Option
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Foster Moreau has caught two passes in each of his three games this season, regularly getting involved as the team's second tight end behind Dalton Schultz. Moreau found the end zone in Week 3 and got a season-high four targets against the Colts, actually getting more targets than Schultz, who only had three. Moreau played 57% of snaps, and his workload is definitely worth watching as the Texans try to figure out who can emerge as an effective option for the struggling offense. Moreau is only the TE45 in RotoBaller's Week 4 rankings, so he isn't a starter outside of the deepest formats yet. However, he is a DFS punt play and a sleeper to watch if he keeps getting so much playing time.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Hauls in two passes in Week 2 loss
metadata.description: Moreau caught both of his targets for 34 yards and added a tackle on special teams during Sunday's 20-6 loss to the Bengals.
metadata.analysis: Moreau was listed as a starter, though he played only 23 of the Texans' 80 offensive plays, well behind Dalton Schultz's 54 snaps. Moreau ended up fourth on the Texans in receiving yards, which included a 25-yard catch early in the second quarter, and he's up to a 4-49-0 receiving line through two regular-season games. The Texans hit the road for Week 3 against the Colts, and while Moreau will contribute on offense and special teams, his pass-catching production will be limited while working behind Schultz.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau Facing Uphill Battle for Playing Time in Houston
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Foster Moreau had a quiet game in his team's Week 1 loss to the Buffalo Bills, recording two catches for 15 yards on two targets. On the bright side, Moreau earned the second-most snaps in the crowded Texans' tight-end room ahead of second-round rookie Marlin Klein and 2024 fourth-rounder Cade Stover. However, veteran Texans tight end Dalton Schultz recorded four catches for 35 yards on eight targets against Buffalo and appears to still have a firm hold on the TE1 job in Houston. The Texans will be without wide receiver Jayden Higgins (knee) for the season and could also be missing star wideout Nico Collins (hamstring) for at least the next couple of games with a hamstring injury. Still, even if Houston continues to lean into formations that utilize multiple tight ends, Moreau's fantasy upside is likely limited as long as Schultz remains healthy.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Lands with Houston
metadata.description: Moreau (ankle) agreed to terms Wednesday on a contract with the Texans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Moreau appears fully recovered from the ankle injury that limited him to 11 regular-season appearances with the Saints in 2025, in which span he secured seven of 10 targets for 46 yards. He had been heavily involved in New Orleans' tight end rotation in 2024, when he logged a 32-413-5 receiving line (43 targets) while playing all 17 regular-season games. Going forward, Moreau will operate as one of Houston's top options behind starting TE Dalton Schultz (calf), who recently inked an extension through 2027.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau signs with Texans
metadata.description: The Texans signed free agent TE Foster Moreau.
metadata.analysis: Moreau leaves New Orleans after three seasons. He will add depth behind Dalton Schultz in the Texans tight end room.

metadata.title: Texans Sign Foster Moreau to Add to Tight End Room
metadata.description: The Houston Texans signed former New Orleans Saints tight end Foster Moreau to an undisclosed deal on Wednesday, a source told Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. Moreau will move to the AFC South after spending the last three seasons in the Big Easy. The 28-year-old former fourth-round pick by the Raiders in 2019 out of LSU caught 60 of his 78 targets for 665 yards and six touchdowns in 43 games (36 starts) in his three years with the Saints. Moreau only played in 11 games in 2025, though, due to an ankle injury. He finished with a career-low seven grabs on 10 targets for 59 yards and no touchdowns. At best, Moreau will serve as the No. 2 tight end in Houston in 2026 behind starter Dalton Schultz, who recently signed an extension through the 2027 campaign. Moreau can be safely ignored in single-TE leagues this fall.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau 'in talks' with Texans
metadata.description: Foster Moreau is reportedly "in talks" with the Texans.
metadata.analysis: Moreau is currently not expected to return to the Saints. He will likely be heading elsewhere in a depth role in free agency.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau (ankle) placed on IR
metadata.description: The Saints placed TE Foster Moreau on injured reserve.
metadata.analysis: The season comes to an end early for Moreau with an ankle injury. He is set to enter free agency this offseason.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Shifts to IR
metadata.description: Moreau (ankle) was placed on the injured reserve list Friday.
metadata.analysis: The 28-year-old from LSU had already been ruled out for the Week 17 matchup against the Titans due to an ankle injury, but he's since moved to IR and will miss the remainder of the season. In 11 appearances this season, Moreau caught seven of 10 targets for 46 yards. Expect Taysom Hill and Jack Stoll to have larger roles in the Saints' tight-end corps over the final two games of the campaign.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Ruled out for Week 17
metadata.description: Coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Moreau (ankle) will not play next Sunday against the Titans, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore said the team will monitor Moreau next week to see if he'll be able to play in the Week 18 regular-season finale against the Falcons. Moreau was injured in Sunday's win over the Jets. Taysom Hill, Jack Stoll and Moliki Matavao will be candidates to see elevated snaps with Moreau out versus Tennessee.

metadata.title: Foster Moreau - Departs Sunday with ankle injury
metadata.description: Moreau is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup versus the Jets due to an ankle issue, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Moreau was injured when he was tackled after making a catch in the third quarter. The veteran tight end has been working as New Orleans' No. 2 option at the position behind Juwan Johnson. If Moreau can't return Sunday, Taysom Hill and/or Jack Stoll could see more offensive snaps.
